entries.title: How sleep works
entries.content: Sleep cycles through stages called NREM and REM through the night. NHLBI notes many adults don't get enough sleep.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Several short nights add up
entries.content: Research shows several nights of short sleep can affect attention, memory and mood. A regular sleep schedule helps.
entries.source: The consequences of sleep deprivation on cognitive performance - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Sleep and the brain's cleanup
entries.content: Studies describe a 'glymphatic' system that clears waste from the brain during sleep. Researchers are still learning how this relates to long-term brain health.
entries.source: The consequences of sleep deprivation on cognitive performance - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
